## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.8`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noYamlEmptySequenceEntries`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`yml/no-empty-sequence-entry`](https://ota-meshi.github.io/eslint-plugin-yml/rules/no-empty-sequence-entry.html)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noYamlEmptySequenceEntries": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow empty items in YAML lists.

In YAML, each item of a list written on separate lines starts with a `-`.
A `-` with nothing after it adds an item with no value, which YAML reads as `null`.
This usually happens by mistake, when a value is forgotten or a `-` is left behind.

An item that has only a tag (such as `!!str`) or an anchor (such as `&name`), and no value, is also empty.

If the item is meant to have no value, write `null` or `~` to make that clear.

## Examples

### Invalid

```yaml
fruits:
  - apple
  -
  - banana
```

### Valid

```yaml
fruits:
  - apple
  - banana
  - null
  - ~
empty: []
```
